content: Hahoi BAWIPA ni lawk a pathung teh,

content.text: Athakasaipounge, hoi lawk ka oun e ni ama teh a yue han na maw,
Cathut ma ni pathung yawkaw seh khe, telah atipouh.

content: Job ni BAWIPA hah a pathung teh,

content.text: Khenhaw! kai teh banghai cungkeihoehe lah ka o,
bangtelamaw ka pathung han,
ka pahni teh ka tabuem toe.
Vai touh ka dei toung dawkvah, ka pathung mahoeh toe.
Vai hni touh e teh bout ka dei mahoeh toe telah a ti.

content: Cathut ni Job rek a pathung
Hottelah Cathut ni Job hah bongparui thung hoi a pathung teh hettelah a dei:

content.text: Atuvah tongpatang lah coungkacoe awmh.
Lawk na pacei vaiteh na pathung han.
Ka lawkcengnae hah na pathung katang han maw,
na yon hoeh nahanlah yon na pen han maw.
Cathut patetlah kut na tawn maw,
ama patetlah pawlawk na cai sak thai maw.
Taluenae hoi raimonae lah kamthoup haw,
bawilennae hoi na meihawinae kamthoup.
Na lungkhueknae e hah tâcawt sak haw,
Kâoup e pueng hah khen nateh pabawt haw.
Kâoup e pueng hah khen nateh rahnoum sak haw,
tamikathoutnaw hah a onae hmuen dawkvah repcoungroe sin awh.
Vaiphu dawk cungtalah be hrawk awh,
kâhrawk e hmonae hoi a minhmai hah ramuk awh.
Hottelah aranglae na kut ni na rungngang thai e hah,
kai ni hai ka pâpho han.
Khenhaw! nama patetlah ka sak e Behemoth heh
maitotan patetlah pho kahring a ca van.
A keng dawk e thaonae hoi a vonpui dawk e
tharui hnotithainae hah khenhaw!
A mai teh sidar thing patetlah a kâroe sak teh,
a phai dawk e tharuinaw teh a bawk bawk lah ao.
A hrunaw teh rahum khom patetlah ao teh, a nâhru teh sum khom patetlah ao.
Cathut e lamthung dawk hoi ahni te pasuek e lah a o,
ahni dueng doeh kasakkung ni tahloi hoi kâhnai sak e lah ao.
Monnaw ni ca hane a tâco sak,
hawvah moithangnaw pueng ni a pai awh.
Lotus thingkung rahim vah a tabo teh,
lungpum rahim hoi tuinawk dawk hai ouk ao.
Lotus thingkung tâhlip ni a ngue awh,
palang rai e sumpakungnaw ni a kalup.
palang tui teh a len thai,
hateiteh banglah noutna hoeh,
apâhni totouh Jordan tui kalen nakunghai a lungmawng.
A mit hoi a khet lahun nah,
naphai do thai han namaw.
